# TodoList Application - Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
A Next.js todolist application with Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL database, and Tailwind CSS for office team progress tracking.

## Tech Stack
- Next.js 14+ with App Router
- TypeScript
- Prisma ORM
- PostgreSQL
- Tailwind CSS
- Dark theme (dark background, light text)
